messages:
nina: Heads up - release hold. CI gating tests failing in canary with a flaky DB migration test. Looks intermittent but currently blocks the promote.

release-bot: [CI] canary-e2e/db-migrations #204 failed  migration-step 'add-customer-index' timed out. See logs: https://ci.redwood/204 :exclamation:

chao: I saw this earlier. The migration sometimes hits a lock on the 'customers' table when analytics batch jobs are running. Could be contention from the nightly analytics pipeline.

paul: We can (a) pause analytics jobs for the window, (b) re-run migrations with lower concurrency, or (c) pin promote to previous canary if we need to move quickly.

nina: I'd prefer (a) briefly pause analytics jobs. Can we coordinate with data infra?

infra-bot: Noted: Analytics ingestion job cluster scheduled at 1754098900. If paused, ingestion backlog will grow by ~10k events but catch-up possible. Suggested action: pause ingestion for 7 minutes.

paul: I'll call data infra now. Meanwhile, re-run the failing canary migration with serial mode.

chao: Re-run started: migrate --serial --backoff=3s.

release-bot: canary-e2e/db-migrations #205 queued  running serial migration.

paul: Data infra confirmed pause for 7 minutes. We'll watch for lock contention.

release-bot: canary-e2e/db-migrations #205 succeeded  migration applied in serial mode.

nina: Great. Unholding promotion. Note in release ticket: "Hold (7m) while pausing analytics ingestion to avoid migration locks; applied serial migration; promote resumed." Filing follow-up: Add migration advisory in our deploy runbook.

chao: Follow-up: add a pre-migration check that detects active long-running queries on affected tables. Filed: ENG-OPS-1182.

release-bot: Promote to staging completed. Leaving thread open for 15m for post-migration verification.
